[win/mac/linux] [web - flash] Last Legacy - large exploratory sidescroller

In the same vein as Iji or Cave Story or Phoenotopia, this is a large sidescroller with secrets to find and puzzles to solve and lots of action. This one isn't on quite the same scale as any of those, but unlike those there's a sequel already released and a third game on the way.

Come to think of it, maybe characterizing it as "exploratory" was a little inaccurate, at least compared to the others. There are secrets to find, but despite that the levels are largely linear. I'm not going to sweat the classification, but recognize that this is a different game and that you should come into it with different expectations.

This is done in flash, with stand alone clients available for win / mac / linux as well as a web version.
